invariants.reason: Reuses the single existing kernel and commit authority.
No file or format knowledge enters the kernel or energy seam.
Physical state, temporary provenance, forcing/provider data and results remain distinct.
No persistent per-column provenance or energy state is added.
Prepared energy/provenance is private worker/job-local transaction scratch.
No global candidate registry or per-column heavyweight solver object is introduced.
The frozen path prepares locally, commits the same candidate and publishes only after accepted commit.
No replay-sensitive persistent token is required and retries can rebuild local preparation cheaply.
Association is interval-generic and has no day/calendar assumption.
No coupling-window duration is hard coded.
External donor provenance is treated as runtime/coupler composition without weakening transaction semantics.
No groundwater head/flux contract is altered and water exchange authority remains existing accepted bottom exchange.
Energy publication performs no second water or mass booking.
Interface sensitivity outputs are unaffected.
No extra physical SWAP solve is introduced for provenance.
Private local scratch and no global registry are compatible with MultiSWAP batching.
No MODFLOW cell/tile cardinality assumption is introduced.
External temperature source remains generic and may be a deep-vadose component outside SWAP.
No component water transfer or storage transition is changed.
The provenance rule is outside soil-water solver internals and can wrap alternative solvers.
Existing thermal carrier and sensible-enthalpy physics are reused unchanged.
No HeadCalc or Richards internal array dependency is introduced.
Provenance/publication policy is not used to silently alter physical options.
No unbounded retry or global uniqueness coordination is added.
Reference mode remains available and unchanged.
Incomplete accepted energy must be explicit diagnostics, not silent substitution.
Inactive energy accounting adds no persistent state and no required binding allocation.
Runtime/coupler owns external donor composition and source identity.
No midnight, daily run, legacy input or MODFLOW-specific assumption is added.
This audit explicitly evaluates all 30 architecture invariants.
